questions.question: Which platforms should a solo drone operator focus on first?
questions.questionHtml: Which platforms should a solo drone operator focus on first?

answers.text: Every major platform — be everywhere your buyers might be

answers.text: Two platforms — one for discovery, one for trust — and ignore the rest for at least six months

questions.feedback: The two-platform rule keeps you focused. One discovery platform brings new people in, one trust platform deepens relationships. More than two splits your attention before you have momentum.
questions.feedbackHtml: Pick two platforms — one discovery, one trust — and ignore the rest at first.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of batching social media work (capture → edit → caption → schedule)?
questions.questionHtml: What is the main benefit of batching social media work (capture → edit → caption → schedule)?

answers.text: Higher reach on the algorithm
answers.textHtml: Higher reach on the algorithm

answers.text: It turns social into a focused weekly task instead of a daily drain
answers.textHtml: It turns social into a focused weekly task instead of a daily drain

answers.text: It guarantees viral content
answers.textHtml: It guarantees viral content

answers.text: It is a requirement of every scheduling tool
answers.textHtml: It is a requirement of every scheduling tool

questions.feedback: Batching protects your time. You spend three to four focused hours and cover two weeks — far more sustainable than trying to post in real time.
questions.feedbackHtml: Batching makes social a weekly task, not a daily drain.

answers.text: Followers do not pay invoices — quality of audience matters more than quantity
answers.textHtml: Followers do not pay invoices — quality of audience matters more than quantity

answers.text: Algorithms ignore follower counts entirely
